units.literal: That year the Ministry of War memorialized that awaiting-appointment and candidate garrison commandants and company commanders, like civil officials, could purchase additional dispatch and study with the grain transport.

units.zh: 明年，浙江巡撫三寶奏請教職捐不論雙單月即用者，設加捐分發，到省委用。
units.en: The next year, Zhejiang Governor Sanbao requested educational officials of all immediate-use categories could purchase dispatch and be employed on arrival.
units.literal: The next year, Zhejiang Governor Sanbao memorialized that educational officials contributing regardless of bi- or monthly immediate use could set additional dispatch and be employed provincially on arrival.

units.zh: 均報可。
units.en: All were approved.
units.literal: All were approved.

units.zh: 川運例停分發，歸入常例報捐，為永例。
units.en: Sichuan transport dispatch was halted and incorporated into standing contributions as a permanent rule.
units.literal: Sichuan transport regulations halted dispatch; it was incorporated into standing contribution reporting as a permanent rule.

units.zh: 四十二年，以山東布政使陸燿言東省分發佐雜漸多，停布政司經歷、理問、州同以下佐雜官分發例。
units.en: In Qianlong 42, because Shandong Commissioner Lu Yao reported too many dispatched deputies, dispatch of registrars and lower deputies was halted.
units.literal: In the forty-second year, because Shandong Provincial Administration Commissioner Lu Yao said dispatched deputies in the east were gradually numerous, dispatch of provincial administration experience, director of studies, department assistant, and lower deputies was halted.

units.zh: 四十六年，候補布政司經歷鄭肇芳等、候選州同張衍齡等具呈戶部，以投供日久，部選無期，各省佐雜班已疏通，請准報捐分發，為奏行如舊例。
units.en: In Qianlong 46, awaiting-appointment provincial administration registrar Zheng Zhaofang and others and candidate department assistant Zhang Yanling and others petitioned the Ministry of Revenue: after long waits with no selection, provincial deputy quotas were clear—they requested purchase dispatch, and the old rule was restored.
units.literal: In the forty-sixth year, awaiting-appointment provincial administration experience Zheng Zhaofang and others and candidate department assistant Zhang Yanling and others petitioned the Ministry of Revenue: having reported for duty long with no ministry selection in sight, provincial deputy quotas were already cleared—they requested permission to report contribution for dispatch, and memorialized implementation as in the old rule.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年，給事中廣興請將俊秀附生報捐道、府、州、縣者，停銓實缺，准加捐分發。
units.en: In Jiaqing 4, Supervising Secretary Guang Xing requested genteel supplemental students purchasing circuit through county posts halt substantive selection and purchase dispatch instead.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, Supervising Secretary Guang Xing requested that genteel supplemental students reporting contribution for circuit, prefectural, departmental, and county posts halt substantive selection and be permitted additional dispatch by contribution.

units.zh: 責成督、撫試看三年，酌量題補。
units.en: Governors were to observe them for three years before recommending appointment.
units.literal: Governors were charged to observe them for three years and recommend appointment as appropriate.

units.zh: 帝以停選示人不信，令加捐分發，有礙政體，不允行。
units.en: The emperor held that halting selection showed distrust; permitting purchase dispatch harmed governance and was rejected.
units.literal: The emperor held that halting selection showed distrust of the people; permitting additional dispatch by contribution harmed proper governance and was not permitted.

units.zh: 道、咸間，增加捐指省例。
units.en: Between the Daoguang and Xianfeng eras, purchase for designated-province dispatch increased.
units.literal: Between Daoguang and Xianfeng, contribution for designated-province dispatch was increased.

units.zh: 光緒四年，捐例停，而分髮指省以常例得報捐如故。
units.en: In Guangxu 4, purchase regulations halted, but designated-province dispatch continued under standing regulations.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu, contribution regulations stopped, but dispatch to designated provinces could still be reported under standing regulations as before.

units.zh: 五年，御史孔憲以指省分發，流弊不可勝言，請罷之。
units.en: In Guangxu 5, Censor Kong Xian, citing countless abuses of designated-province dispatch, requested abolishing it.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Censor Kong Xian, because designated-province dispatch had abuses beyond counting, requested abolishing it.

units.zh: 格部議，不果行。
units.en: The ministry blocked it.
units.literal: Blocked by ministry deliberation, it was not implemented.

units.zh: 八年，復申前請，部覆如議。
units.en: In Guangxu 8, the request was renewed; the ministry approved.
units.literal: In the eighth year, the previous request was renewed; the ministry replied as deliberated.

units.zh: 未幾，海防例開，仍准報捐。
units.en: Soon coastal defense regulations reopened and purchases were permitted again.
units.literal: Before long, coastal defense regulations opened and reporting contributions was again permitted.

units.zh: 時分發人員擁擠殊甚，疆吏輒奏停分發，期滿復請展限，各直省比比然也。
units.en: Dispatched personnel crowded every province; governors repeatedly halted dispatch and requested extensions when terms expired.
units.literal: At the time dispatched personnel were extremely crowded; frontier officials repeatedly memorialized to halt dispatch, and when terms expired requested extensions—every province was alike.

units.zh: 定例，捐納官分發各部、院學習三年，外省試用一年。
units.en: By regulation, purchased officials dispatched to capital departments studied three years; in provinces they served one year on probation.
units.literal: By regulation, contributed officials dispatched to departments and courts studied three years; in the provinces they served probation one year.

units.zh: 期滿，各堂官、督、撫實行甄別奏留，乃得補官。
units.en: On expiry, department heads and governors evaluated them and memorialized retention before appointment.
units.literal: When terms expired, department heads and governors conducted real evaluation and memorialized retention before they could fill posts.

units.zh: 嘉慶十六年，諭：「捐納員簽分部、院學習行走年滿，當詳加甄別。
units.en: In Jiaqing 16, an edict declared: "Purchased officials completing departmental study must be carefully evaluated.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year of Jiaqing, an edict said: "Contributed officials assigned to departments and courts who complete their study term should be carefully evaluated.

units.zh: 近來該堂官於行走報滿人員，無不保留。
units.en: Recently department heads retained every official reporting completion.
units.literal: Recently these department heads retain all who report completion of service.

units.zh: 市恩邀譽，不顧登進之濫，可為寒心。」
units.en: Currying favor while disregarding indiscriminate advancement—this was chilling."
units.literal: Currying favor and seeking reputation, disregarding the excess of advancement—this is chilling."

units.zh: 道光八年，諭：「酌增常例報捐，分發人員為數更多，著各督、撫、鹽政留心察看，不必拘定年限，認真甄覈。」
units.en: In Daoguang 8, an edict declared: "With more dispatched personnel under adjusted standing contributions, governors and salt commissioners must observe carefully, not bound by fixed terms, and evaluate earnestly."
units.literal: In the eighth year of Daoguang, an edict said: "With adjusted standing contributions, dispatched personnel are more numerous; governors and salt commissioners should observe carefully, not bound by fixed terms, and evaluate earnestly."

units.zh: 然奉行日久，長官循例奏留，徒有甄別之名，不盡遵上指也。
units.en: Yet over time superiors routinely memorialized retention—evaluation existed in name only, not in practice.
units.literal: Yet practiced long, superiors routinely memorialized retention—evaluation existed in name only, not fully following the imperial intent.

units.zh: 咸豐七年，從御史何兆瀛請，詔各部、院考試捐納司員，察其能否辦理案牘。
units.en: In Xianfeng 7, following Censor He Zhaoying's request, departments and courts were ordered to test purchased clerks on document handling.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Xianfeng, following Censor He Zhaoying's request, an edict ordered departments and courts to examine contributed clerks on whether they could handle documents.

units.zh: 尋兵部試以論題，御史硃文江以為言，詔切責之。
units.en: Soon the Ministry of War tested with essays; Censor Zhu Wenjiang complained, and an edict sharply rebuked them.
units.literal: Soon the Ministry of War tested with essay topics; Censor Zhu Wenjiang spoke of this, and an edict sharply rebuked them.

units.zh: 命嗣後毋得以考試虛文，徒飾觀聽。
units.en: Henceforth examinations were forbidden as empty formalities for show.
units.literal: It was ordered that hereafter examinations must not be empty formalities merely for show.

units.zh: 外官分發到省，例由督、撫考試，分別等第，黜陟有差。
units.en: Provincial officials were examined by governors on arrival, graded, and promoted or dismissed accordingly.
units.literal: Provincial officials dispatched to provinces were by regulation examined by governors, graded, and promoted or dismissed with differences.

units.zh: 光緒初，各省遵例考試，顧雲南有咨回降調者。
units.en: Early in the Guangxu era provinces followed examination regulations, though Yunnan returned some with demotion.
units.literal: Early in Guangxu, provinces followed regulations in examination, but Yunnan had some returned with demotion.

units.zh: 五年，詔各省考試捐納人員，府、廳、州、縣試論一，佐雜試告示判語。
units.en: In Guangxu 5, an edict ordered provincial examination of purchased officials: prefects and magistrates wrote one essay; deputies judged proclamations.
units.literal: In the fifth year, an edict ordered provinces to examine contributed personnel: prefectural, departmental, and county officials took one essay; deputies took proclamation judgment.

units.zh: 八年，閩浙總督何璟言：「閩省應試府、廳、州、縣百五十四員，鹽大使五十五員，佐雜五百九十六員，知府、直隸州知州、鹽大使取留十之五，同、通、佐雜留十之四。」
units.en: In Guangxu 8, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General He Jing reported: "Fujian examined 154 prefectural and county officials, 55 salt commissioners, and 596 deputies; prefects and salt commissioners were retained at fifty percent, sub-prefects and deputies at forty percent."
units.literal: In the eighth year, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor He Jing said: "In Fujian, 154 prefectural and county examinees, 55 salt commissioners, and 596 deputies took examination; of prefects, Zhili department magistrates, and salt commissioners five-tenths were retained, of sub-prefects, sub-circuit magistrates, and deputies four-tenths."

units.zh: 報聞。
units.en: This was reported to the court.
units.literal: This was reported.

units.zh: 三十三年，憲政編查館議覆御史趙炳麟疏，捐納道、府、同、通、州、縣佐雜未到省者，入吏部學治館肄業半年。
units.en: In Guangxu 33, the Constitutional Research Bureau replied to Censor Zhao Binglin: purchased officials not yet in province should study half a year at the Ministry of Personnel's Governance Academy.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year, the Constitutional Research Bureau replied to Censor Zhao Binglin's memorial: contributed circuit, prefectural, sub-prefect, sub-circuit, departmental, county, and deputy officials not yet arrived in province should study half a year at the Ministry of Personnel's Governance Academy.

units.zh: 已到省，入法政學堂肄業，長期三年，速成一年有半。
units.en: Those already in province entered law schools for three years or an accelerated eighteen months.
units.literal: Those already in province entered law schools: long course three years, accelerated one and a half years.

units.zh: 尋議上考驗外官章程，各省遵章考試，間亦罷黜數人，以應明詔，而于澄清吏治之道無補也。
units.en: Soon examination regulations for provincial officials were adopted; provinces occasionally dismissed a few to satisfy the edict—but this did little to clarify official governance.
units.literal: Soon regulations for examining provincial officials were submitted; provinces followed in examination and occasionally dismissed a few to respond to the clear edict—but this did not aid the path of clarifying official governance.

units.zh: 貢監捐清初已行。
units.en: Tribute and academy purchases were practiced from early in the Qing.
units.literal: Tribute and academy contributions were practiced from early Qing.

units.zh: 監捐沿明納粟例。
units.en: Academy purchase followed the Ming grain-purchase precedent.
units.literal: Academy contribution followed the Ming grain-purchase precedent.

units.zh: 順治十二年，開廩生捐銀准貢例，從御史楊義請也。
units.en: In Shunzhi 12, granary students were permitted to purchase tribute status with silver, on Censor Yang Yi's request.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi, the regulation for granary students contributing silver for permitted tribute was opened, following Censor Yang Yi's request.

units.zh: 十七年，禮部以亢旱日久，請暫開准貢，令士民納銀賑濟。
units.en: In Shunzhi 17, the Ministry of Rites, citing prolonged drought, requested temporarily opening permitted tribute for relief contributions.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Ministry of Rites, because drought had lasted long, requested temporarily opening permitted tribute so scholars and commoners could contribute silver for relief.

units.zh: 允之。
units.en: This was granted.
units.literal: This was granted.

units.zh: 貢監例得考職，康熙六年，御史李棠言：「進士、舉人遲至十年始得一官，今例監考補中書，三年後即升部屬，應停罷。」
units.en: Tribute and academy students could take office examinations; in Kangxi 6, Censor Li Tang said: "Jinshi and juren wait ten years for a post, while purchased students become Secretariat drafters and ministry staff in three years—this should stop."
units.literal: Tribute and academy students were permitted examination for office; in the sixth year of Kangxi, Censor Li Tang said: "Jinshi and juren wait as long as ten years for one post; now purchased academy students examine for Secretariat drafter and after three years rise to ministry staff—this should be stopped."

units.zh: 部覆如議。
units.en: The ministry agreed.
units.literal: The ministry replied as deliberated.

units.zh: 自是貢監考職，祗以州同、州判、縣丞、主簿、吏目用。
units.en: Thereafter tribute and academy examination for office was limited to department assistants, department judges, county assistants, registrars, and clerks.
units.literal: From this, tribute and academy examination for office used only department assistant, department judge, county assistant, registrar, and clerk posts.

units.zh: 初考職例行，各省監生或憚遠道跋涉，或因文理不通，多倩代頂冒者。
units.en: When the rule first operated, students either feared distant travel or, being unlettered, hired substitutes.
units.literal: When the examination-for-office rule first operated, provincial academy students either feared distant travel or, being unlettered, often hired substitutes to impersonate them.

units.zh: 世宗深知其弊，特遣大臣司考試。
units.en: The Yongzheng Emperor knew the abuses well and dispatched grand ministers to supervise examinations.
units.literal: Shizong knew the abuses well and specially dispatched grand ministers to supervise examination.

units.zh: 雍正五年，令與考者千一百餘人悉引見，時以頂冒避匿者九百餘人。
units.en: In Yongzheng 5, over eleven hundred examinees were presented; over nine hundred had used substitutes or evaded examination.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, over eleven hundred examinees were all presented; at the time over nine hundred had impersonated or evaded by hiding.

units.zh: 帝於引見員中揀選七十餘人，授內、外官有差。
units.en: The emperor selected over seventy and appointed them to capital and provincial posts.
units.literal: The emperor selected over seventy from those presented and appointed them to capital and provincial posts with differences in rank.

units.zh: 乾隆元年，停考職。
units.en: In Qianlong 1, examination for office was stopped.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, examination for office was stopped.

units.zh: 三年，令捐納貢監如歲貢例，分別等第，以主簿、吏目考取。
units.en: In Qianlong 3, purchased tribute and academy students were graded like annual tribute graduates and examined for registrar and clerk posts.
units.literal: In the third year, contributed tribute and academy students were ordered like annual tribute graduates to be graded and examined for registrar and clerk posts.

units.zh: 捐監未滿三年者不與。
units.en: Purchased academy students of less than three years were excluded.
units.literal: Purchased academy students of less than three years were not included.

units.zh: 道光後，考職例罷。
units.en: After the Daoguang era, examination for office was abolished.
units.literal: After Daoguang, the examination-for-office rule was abolished.

units.zh: 雍正間，帝以積貯宜裕，允廣東、江、浙、湖廣以本色納監。
units.en: During the Yongzheng era, the emperor permitted Guangdong, Jiangsu-Zhejiang, and Huguang to pay academy fees in grain.
units.literal: During Yongzheng, the emperor, holding that stores should be ample, permitted Guangdong, Jiangsu-Zhejiang, and Huguang to contribute to the academy in kind.

units.zh: 乾隆元年，罷一切捐例。
units.en: In Qianlong 1, all purchase regulations were abolished.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, all contribution regulations were abolished.

units.zh: 廷議捐監為士子應試之階，請於戶部收捐，備各省賑濟，從之。
units.en: The court held that academy purchase was a step toward examinations; collection at the Ministry of Revenue for provincial relief was approved.
units.literal: The court deliberated that academy contribution was a step for scholars to take examinations; it requested collection at the Ministry of Revenue for provincial relief, and this was followed.

units.zh: 三年，詔復行常平捐監例，各省得一體納本色。
units.en: In Qianlong 3, an edict restored ever-normal granary academy purchases; all provinces could pay in grain.
units.literal: In the third year, an edict restored the ever-normal granary academy-contribution regulations; all provinces could uniformly contribute in kind.

units.zh: 原定各省捐穀三千餘萬石，數年僅得二百五十餘萬石，復令戶部兼收折色。
units.en: Provinces were to contribute over thirty million shi of grain; in several years barely 2.5 million were collected—the Ministry of Revenue was again ordered to accept silver payments.
units.literal: Originally each province was to contribute over thirty million shi of grain; in several years barely two and a half million shi were obtained—the Ministry of Revenue was again ordered to collect commuted payments as well.

units.zh: 十年，湖廣總督鄂彌達言：「捐監事例，穀不如銀。
units.en: In Qianlong 10, Huguang Governor-General E Miada said: "For academy purchases, grain is inferior to silver.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Huguang Governor-General E Miada said: "For academy contribution regulations, grain is inferior to silver.

units.zh: 銀有定數，穀無成價。
units.en: Silver has a fixed rate; grain has no fixed price.
units.literal: Silver has a fixed amount; grain has no fixed price.

units.zh: 易捐穀為捐銀，倘遇荒歉，亦可動支採買。」
units.en: Switching from grain to silver, funds could still be drawn to buy grain in famine."
units.literal: Changing grain contribution to silver contribution, if famine occurs funds can still be drawn to purchase grain."

units.zh: 允行。
units.en: This was approved.
units.literal: This was permitted.

units.zh: 大學士等復言：「各省納本色，有名無實，請停止，專由部收折色。」
units.en: Grand secretaries again said: "Provincial grain payments were nominal only—stop them and have the ministry collect silver alone."
units.literal: Grand secretaries again said: "Provincial payment in kind is nominal without reality—request stopping it and having the ministry alone collect commuted payments."

units.zh: 得旨：「各省收捐不必停，在部捐折色者聽。」
units.en: An edict ruled: "Provincial collection need not stop; contributors paying silver at the ministry were permitted."
units.literal: An edict said: "Provincial collection need not stop; those contributing commuted payments at the ministry may do so."

units.zh: 三十一年，以陝、甘監捐積弊最甚，詔停罷。
units.en: In Qianlong 31, because Shaanxi and Gansu academy purchases had the worst abuses, an edict halted them.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year, because Shaanxi and Gansu academy contributions had the worst accumulated abuses, an edict halted them.

units.zh: 尋並罷安徽、直隸、山西、河南、湖南北，惟雲南、福建、廣東收本色如舊。
units.en: Soon Anhui, Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, and Hunan-Hubei were halted too; only Yunnan, Fujian, and Guangdong continued grain collection.
units.literal: Soon Anhui, Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, and Hunan-Hubei were also halted; only Yunnan, Fujian, and Guangdong collected in kind as before.

units.zh: 三十九年，陝西巡撫畢沅、陝總督勒爾謹請如例收納監糧，允之。
units.en: In Qianlong 39, Shaanxi Governor Bi Yuan and Shaan-Gan Governor-General Le Erjin requested collecting academy grain as regulated; approval was granted.
units.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, Shaanxi Governor Bi Yuan and Shaan-Gan Governor-General Le Erjin requested collecting academy grain as per regulations; this was granted.

units.zh: 是年甘省奏報六個月內捐監萬九千十七名，監糧八十餘萬石。
units.en: That year Gansu reported 19,017 academy purchasers and over 800,000 shi of grain collected in six months.
units.literal: That year Gansu reported that within six months 19,017 academy contributors and over 800,000 shi of academy grain were collected.

units.zh: 帝疑之。
units.en: The emperor grew suspicious.
units.literal: The emperor was suspicious.

units.zh: 布政使王亶望主其事，私收折色，減成包辦，更虛報賑災，侵冒鉅款。
units.en: Provincial Commissioner Wang Tanwang directed it, privately collecting silver at reduced rates, monopolizing contracts, falsely reporting disaster relief, and embezzling vast sums.
units.literal: Provincial Administration Commissioner Wang Tanwang directed the affair, privately collecting commuted payments, reducing rates and monopolizing contracts, further falsely reporting disaster relief, and embezzling vast sums.

units.zh: 繼任布政使王廷贊知其弊，不能革。
units.en: His successor Wang Tingzan knew the abuses but could not stop them.
units.literal: His successor Wang Tingzan knew the abuses but could not reform them.

units.zh: 事覺，置亶望、勒爾謹、廷贊於法，官吏緣是罷黜者數十人，報捐監生或加捐職官者，分別停科、罰俸、停選。
units.en: When exposed, Wang Tanwang, Le Erjin, and Wang Tingzan were punished according to law; dozens of officials were dismissed; contributors were barred from examinations, fined, or halted in selection.
units.literal: When the matter was exposed, Wang Tanwang, Le Erjin, and Wang Tingzan were punished by law; dozens of officials were dismissed thereby; academy students or those who added contribution for official rank were respectively barred from examinations, fined salary, or halted in selection.

units.zh: 其後監捐無復納粟遺意矣。
units.en: After this, academy purchase no longer retained the original intent of grain contribution.
units.literal: After this, academy contribution no longer retained the original intent of contributing grain.

units.zh: 貢捐屬常例，向於部庫報捐。
units.en: Tribute purchase fell under standing regulations and was reported at the ministry treasury.
units.literal: Tribute contribution belonged to standing regulations and was reported at the ministry treasury.

units.zh: 嘉慶間，疆吏屢以為請，輒阻部議。
units.en: During the Jiaqing era, provincial officials repeatedly requested this but the ministry always blocked it.
units.literal: During Jiaqing, frontier officials repeatedly requested this but were always blocked by ministry deliberation.

units.zh: 十二年，部臣言庫帑充裕，請變通常例，各省一體收捐。
units.en: In Jiaqing 12, ministry officials cited a full treasury and requested all provinces uniformly collect tribute purchases.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, ministry officials said the treasury was ample and requested changing standing regulations so all provinces could uniformly collect contributions.

units.zh: 報可。
units.en: Approval was granted.
units.literal: Approval was granted.

units.zh: 此外尚有捐馬百匹予紀錄、運丁三年多交米三百石給頂帶之例。
units.en: There were also regulations for contributing one hundred horses for merit records, and for transport workers delivering extra rice for rank insignia.
units.literal: Besides this there were regulations for contributing one hundred horses for merit records, and for transport workers over three years delivering an extra three hundred shi of rice for rank insignia.

units.zh: 其樂善好施例內，凡捐資修葺文廟、城垣、書院、義學、考棚、義倉、橋樑、道路，或捐輸穀米銀兩，分別議敘、頂帶、職銜、加級、紀錄有差。
units.en: Under charitable-contribution regulations, those funding repairs to temples, walls, academies, schools, examination halls, granaries, bridges, and roads, or contributing grain or silver, received graded rewards of merit review, insignia, nominal rank, grade increases, or merit records.
units.literal: Within the charitable-contribution regulations, all who contributed funds to repair Confucian temples, city walls, academies, charity schools, examination sheds, charity granaries, bridges, and roads, or contributed grain, rice, or silver, received differentiated merit review, rank insignia, nominal rank, grade increase, or merit records.

units.zh: 餘如各省鹽商、士紳，捐輸鉅款，酌予獎敘。
units.en: Provincial salt merchants and gentry who contributed large sums also received discretionary awards.
units.literal: Others such as provincial salt merchants and gentry who contributed large sums received discretionary awards.

units.zh: 皆出自急公好義，與捐納相似，而實不同也。
units.en: All sprang from public-spirited generosity; they resemble purchase of office but were in fact different.
units.literal: All sprang from public-minded righteousness; they resemble purchase of office but are in fact different.
